## Editorial Context

FactZone explains science, psychology, nature, technology, AI, history, mysteries, space, everyday phenomena, digital safety, careers and online topics in accessible Hindi.

FactZone's Editorial Policy describes its approach to research, fact-checking, AI-assisted content, corrections and updates. It says relevant claims may be checked against scientific publications, academic and institutional sources, government/public institutions, primary sources and reputable reporting. AI-generated information is not treated as automatically factual.

## Clean URL Convention

All article URLs in this file intentionally omit the legacy `.html` suffix. For example:

Legacy: https://factzone.online/posts/why-songs-get-stuck-in-head-earworm-hindi.html
Clean:  https://factzone.online/posts/why-songs-get-stuck-in-head-earworm-hindi

When deploying this structure, legacy `.html` URLs should permanently redirect to the corresponding clean URL where possible.

## Maintenance Rules

- Add every newly published article to both `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`.
- Keep the clean URL identical to the site's canonical URL.
- If a slug changes, update the old-to-new redirect and both LLM files.
- Remove deleted articles from both files.
- Do not invent URLs that are not actually published or planned as canonical URLs.
- For current, medical, financial, legal, statistical or otherwise high-impact claims, use the individual article plus authoritative primary sources where appropriate.
